I wrote `factory/runs/002-blank-title-rejected/spec.md` and changed nothing else. I didn't run any tests.

The spec has four acceptance criteria, all observable through `create_task`:
1. An empty title raises `ValidationError` with "Title is required."
2. A title of only spaces (`"   "`) raises the same error.
3. A title of only tabs or newlines (`"\t\n"`) raises the same error.
4. A normal title such as `"Buy milk"` returns a `Task` with that title.

The test line is `Test: app/tests/test_tasks.py::test_sr_1_1_blank_title_rejected`, and "Out of scope" is copied from the issue.

`validate_new_task` in `app/tasks.py` already has the SR-1.1 check. The spec says so in a note: this run adds a test for existing behaviour and needs no code change. The factory's red gate expects the new test to fail, so with the rule already in place the run may stop there. That decision is for a person.
